title: Serakki project authoring schema
description: A strict game.json root, UID-owned item fragment, or Editor audio metadata file.

meta.description: Core metadata and player-available layouts for this game.

resources.description: Explicit non-item resource roles used by the game shell.

music.description: Optional global Music behavior for this game.

sfx.description: Optional SFX event assignments for this game.

start.description: The initial Board contents created for a new game.

GameFileSchema.title: Serakki game source file
GameFileSchema.description: The complete game.json contract excluding items owned by items/<uid>.json files.

IdSchema.description: A non-empty exact identity used across Serakki.

PositiveIntegerSchema.description: A whole number greater than zero.

width.description: The positive number of grid cells arranged horizontally.

height.description: The positive number of grid cells arranged vertically.

grid.SizeSchema.description: The explicit width and height of a two-dimensional game grid.

id.description: The stable ID of this game configuration.

title.description: The human-readable title of this game.

introduction.description: Optional Markdown shown before starting a game without a save.

board.description: The size of the board on which items are placed.

MetaSchema.description: Core metadata and player-available layouts for a game.

hero.description: The explicit resource ID used by the game splash hero.

resource.RolesSchema.description: Named non-item resource references required by the game.

playlist.description: Music resource IDs included in the global random playlist.

music.MusicSchema.description: The global random Music playlist authored for one game.

events.description: SFX resource IDs assigned to gameplay and presentation events.

sfx.SfxSchema.description: The event SFX assignments authored for one game.

SfxEventEnumSchema.description: The finite vocabulary of events assignable to SFX.

NonNegativeIntegerSchema.description: A whole number greater than or equal to zero.

space.description: The explicit board space containing this initial item.

itemId.description: The canonical item ID placed on the initial board.

start.BoardItemSchema.description: One canonical item placed at an explicit initial board coordinate.

currentSpace.description: The board space presented when a new game starts.

board.description: The items placed at explicit coordinates when a new game starts.

StartSchema.description: The initial board placements for a new game.

item.description: The canonical item owned by this UID-named file.

ItemFileSchema.title: Serakki item source file
ItemFileSchema.description: One item stored at items/<encoded uid>.json.

item.CompositionSchema.description: A one- or two-layer Artwork composition in back-to-front order.

scale.description: The artwork canvas scale within its full tile, from 0.25 through 1.

default.description: The default one- or two-layer visual composition in back-to-front order.

ArtworkSchema.description: The visual artwork definition for a game item.

amount.description: The positive number of units owned by every fresh item instance.

outcome.description: The optional outcome emitted exactly once from the depleted item's real grid origin.

UnitsSchema.description: A finite unit supply and optional outcome emitted on depletion.

set.description: One or more alternative roll sets provided by this outcome.

OutcomeTableSchema.description: A configured outcome produced by a gameplay source.

weight.description: The positive relative weight used to select this roll set.

rules.description: Availability rules evaluated before this set enters weighted selection.

roll.description: One or more rolls evaluated after this set is selected.

roll.SetSchema.description: An alternative non-empty collection of outcome rolls.

outcome.RuleSchema.description: An availability rule evaluated for an outcome candidate or outcome.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this selected-outcome rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this selected-outcome rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as an enable gate for the selected outcome.

outcome.rule.EnableSchema.description: A rule that enables a selected outcome when its conditions pass.

WhenSchema.description: A standalone condition that evaluates an item-query quantity.

query.description: The query used to find the items evaluated by this condition.

type.description: Identifies this condition as an item-query existence check.

when.ExistsSchema.description: A condition that checks whether an item query returns any quantity.

itemId.description: The stable ID of the selected canonical item.

SelectorSchema.description: A selector that resolves one canonical game item by stable ID.

DistanceSchema.description: Chebyshev distance: self is 0, close is 1, near-close is 1 or 2, near is 2, and far is any positive distance within the origin Board. Universe includes all Board spaces and the origin.

selector.description: The canonical item used to select query candidates.

QuerySchema.description: An item selector and its spatial reach from self through the whole universe.

query.description: The query used to find the items evaluated by this condition.

type.description: Identifies this condition as an exact item-query quantity check.

count.description: The exact item quantity that the query must return.

when.CountSchema.description: A condition that checks an item query against one exact quantity.

query.description: The query used to find the items evaluated by this condition.

type.description: Identifies this condition as an inclusive item-query quantity range check.

min.description: The smallest item quantity accepted by this condition.

max.description: The largest item quantity accepted by this condition.

when.RangeSchema.description: A condition that checks an item query against an inclusive quantity range.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this selected-outcome rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this selected-outcome rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a disable veto for the selected outcome.

outcome.rule.DisableSchema.description: A rule that disables a selected outcome when its conditions pass.

RollSchema.description: A typed roll that an outcome may produce.

outcome.description: One or more outcomes emitted when this roll succeeds.

roll.GuaranteedSchema.description: A roll that guarantees its outcome when its rules allow it.

OutcomeSchema.description: One authored item or space outcome.

itemId.description: The ID of the canonical game item emitted by this outcome.

quantity.description: The quantity emitted by this outcome.

placement.description: The board-placement strategy for this outcome; defaults to a local Manhattan-distance drop.

rules.description: Rules evaluated after this outcome is selected by a successful roll.

ItemOutcomeSchema.description: A canonical game item, quantity, board-placement strategy, and rules for a successful roll's outcome.

min.description: The smallest quantity that may resolve.

max.description: The largest quantity that may resolve.

QuantitySchema.description: The inclusive positive bounds resolved by one quantity contract.

PlacementSchema.description: How a resolved item drop chooses its board origin before canonical nearest-first placement.

SpaceOutcomeSchema.description: Selects the player's Board space when this outcome settles.

chance.description: The probability that this roll provides its outcome, from 0 to 1 inclusive.

outcome.description: One or more outcomes emitted when this roll succeeds.

roll.ChanceSchema.description: A roll that provides its outcome according to a probability.

ChanceSchema.description: A probability from zero to one inclusive.

MergeSchema.description: A discriminated target-specific directional item merge.

target.description: The selector that must match the receiving item for this merge to apply.

action.description: The action applied to the source item after this merge resolves.

outcome.description: The optional extra outcome evaluated after this merge resolves.

effect.description: Identifies this merge as one that spends a unit from its selected target.

merge.SpendSchema.description: A merge that spends one unit from its selected receiving item.

merge.SourceActionSchema.description: The action applied to a source item after it initiates a merge.

target.description: The selector that must match the receiving item for this merge to apply.

action.description: The action applied to the source item after this merge resolves.

outcome.description: The optional extra outcome evaluated after this merge resolves.

effect.description: Identifies this merge as one that keeps its selected target unchanged.

merge.KeepSchema.description: A merge that leaves its selected receiving item unchanged.

target.description: The selector that must match the receiving item for this merge to apply.

action.description: The action applied to the source item after this merge resolves.

outcome.description: The optional extra outcome evaluated after this merge resolves.

effect.description: Identifies this merge as one that removes its selected target.

merge.RemoveSchema.description: A merge that removes its selected receiving item.

target.description: The selector that must match the receiving item for this merge to apply.

action.description: The action applied to the source item after this merge resolves.

outcome.description: The optional extra outcome evaluated after this merge resolves.

effect.description: Identifies this merge as one that replaces its selected target.

result.description: The canonical item that replaces the selected target.

merge.ReplaceSchema.description: A merge that replaces its selected receiving item with an explicit result.

intervalMs.description: Optional active milliseconds between weighted selections from rule-enabled Clock lines for ordinary queue admission; omission creates no pulses.

durationMs.description: Optional active lifetime; expiryMode determines whether accepted work may outlive it.

expiryMode.description: Lifetime expiry policy; omission uses loose-kill. Has no effect without a finite duration.

onExpire.description: Output resolved at owner expiry in both modes; kill-switch places what fits after returned materials and logs the excess as lost, within the same atomic removal.

ItemScheduleSchema.description: Clock-line admission, finite lifetime, or both, with availability rules and expiry outcome.

TimeSchema.description: A non-negative whole time value expressed in milliseconds.

action.RuleSchema.description: Enable gates and disable vetoes evaluated for an immediate item action.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this action rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this action rule to apply.

action.EnableRuleSchema.description: A rule that enables an immediate item action when its conditions pass.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this action rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this action rule to apply.

action.DisableRuleSchema.description: A rule that disables an immediate item action when its conditions pass.

id.description: The stable ID of this product line within its owning item.

title.description: The human-readable title of this product line.

artwork.description: Optional Artwork resource ID shown beside the production line title.

description.description: The human-readable explanation of this product line's purpose.

clock.description: Whether this line participates in weighted Clock selection, independently of Default.

clockWeight.description: Relative Clock selection weight among lines allowed by their evaluated rules.

default.description: Whether this line is the authored fallback default for its owning item.

show.description: Whether this product line is visible before its rules are evaluated.

enable.description: Whether this product line is enabled before its rules are evaluated.

runtimeMs.description: The runtime of this product line in milliseconds; zero completes immediately.

input.description: One or more input requirements for this product line.

outcome.description: The optional result produced when this product line completes.

rules.description: Rules that can change this product line's visibility, availability, or behavior.

LineSchema.description: A single product line with its accepted inputs and produced outcome.

InputSchema.description: A simple, material-item, or Board unit-cost input requirement for a product line.

units.description: The optional unit cost paid by the action owner or this requirement's resolved target.

type.description: Identifies this input as having no consumable resource requirement.

input.SimpleSchema.description: An explicit action requirement with no consumable resource requirement.

cost.description: The positive number of units paid when the enclosing action commits.

from.description: Whether the cost is paid by the action owner or the requirement's resolved target.

input.UnitCostSchema.description: One action-requirement unit cost and the runtime item that pays it.

input.UnitSourceSchema.description: Whether one requirement cost is paid by the action owner or its resolved target.

units.description: The optional unit cost paid by the action owner or this requirement's resolved target.

type.description: Identifies this input as a directly delivered material item.

query.description: The required item and the search scope used by automatic material delivery. Manual delivery uses only the selector.

mode.description: Whether this input is consumed or reserved; defaults to consume.

quantity.description: The exact or bounded total amount accepted across all matching materials.

input.MaterialSchema.description: A directly delivered material item required by a product line.

input.ModeSchema.description: How an input item participates in a product line.

units.description: The optional unit cost paid by the action owner or this requirement's resolved target.

type.description: Identifies this input as one item on the Board that can pay units.

query.description: The board query used to select one target with units for this input.

input.UnitsSchema.description: A board query that resolves one Board item that can pay units.

line.RuleSchema.description: A rule evaluated for a product line.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this product-line rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this product-line rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a request to show the product line.

line.rule.ShowSchema.description: A rule that conditionally makes a product line visible.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this product-line rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this product-line rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a request to hide the product line.

line.rule.HideSchema.description: A rule that hides a product line when its condition is satisfied.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this product-line rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this product-line rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a product-line runtime adjustment.

adjustMs.description: The signed millisecond adjustment added to this product line's runtime.

line.rule.RuntimeAdjustmentSchema.description: A rule that adjusts a product line's runtime by a signed millisecond value.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this product-line rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this product-line rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a product-line runtime multiplier.

multiplier.description: The positive factor multiplied into this product line's runtime.

line.rule.RuntimeMultiplierSchema.description: A rule that multiplies a product line's runtime when its conditions pass.

uid.description: The immutable CUID2 identity of this canonical game item.

id.description: The stable authoring ID of this canonical game item.

title.description: The human-readable title of this item.

draft.description: Whether this item still needs authoring work in the Editor; omitted means false.

description.description: The optional human-readable explanation of this item's purpose.

ui.description: Item interface and player production control: simple shows only information but allows Board clicks on the default line; default enables manual production and always shows all sections, even without production lines.

music.description: Music resource requested while this item detail is open; omission keeps the global playlist.

artwork.description: The visual artwork definition used to render this item.

units.description: The optional supply of units, such as health, resource stock, or uses, and depletion outcome of each item instance.

merge.description: The optional non-empty target-specific merges initiated when this item is dropped onto another item.

maxQueueSize.description: The maximum number of accepted active and queued runs for this item; defaults to one.

lines.description: Optional production lines; an item without lines is passive.

ItemSchema.description: An ordinary item with optional production and Clock scheduling.

AudioResourceMetadataSchema.description: Editor-only display name for one Music or SFX resource.
